enrolled_students.description: Students with at least one enrolment that was not withdrawn in the term

withdrawal_rate.sql: AVG(CASE WHEN status = 'withdrawn' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END)

pass_rate.sql: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' AND letter <> 'F' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('completed', 'denied') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0)
pass_rate.description: Passed among graded enrolments; a denial (DN) counts as graded and failed

credit_hours.description: Credit hours registered, withdrawn courses excluded

weighted_gpa.sql: SUM(grade_points * credit_hours) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') / SUM(credit_hours) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed')
weighted_gpa.description: Grade point average weighted by credit hours, completed courses only

courses_per_student.sql: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'withdrawn') * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'withdrawn')

admitted_students.description: New students admitted; term is the admission term

graduates.description: Students who graduated; term is the graduation term

active_students.description: Students whose status is active today
